essence: The best twice-born should arrange offerings involving buffalo, goat, and cows in this manner.
One should give food and other items accompanied by ghee every day.
One should thus perform the rite in fire daily, or at night.
The rite may be performed in the yard of an elephant stable or a horse stable.
One should smear a pure and pleasant place with cow dung.
